**PlatinVault** by SushiFlux – live Steam achievements as trophy pop-ups and AI-researched 100% guides in one app, for your Unraid server (and as a Windows program).
Open source (GNU AGPL v3). This repository holds the source code, the Unraid template (unraid/platinvault.xml), the README with installation help and the releases. Questions and problems: see the support link.
